about: Real band 68 recordings (guided captures on the bench) that tests/board.mjs replays. For each: when the left and right knocks happened (seconds from the start, a window around the jolt, checked by hand against the capture steps and the band's own tap events), and the true distance between the knocks in cm if it was measured (null if not). A new capture with the distance typed in can be added here.

recordings.about: Gentle knocks (0.47 and 0.49 g jumps; a harder 2.85 g knock 0.8 s after the right one). The band's tap detector heard only that last one, 0.4 s late, so the board never set up before knocks were found in the motion. On its own board; the person said the width came out right (not tape-measured, so not checked).

Firm knocks (4.3 and 7.7 g peaks); writing with jolts up to 1.6 g, as strong as a gentle knock, which must not be taken for knocks. On its own board; the person said the width came out right (not tape-measured, so not checked).
